svg.text: An external investigation procedure for small local LLMs in security alert triage
picks its own probes, repeats them, runs out of budget
always asks for one more probe, even at p > 0.999
The controller stops and cites evidence; the verifier confirms “exposed admin panel”.
Real episode sec-base-02, stopping study. Circle area = posterior; rings = eliminated.
Tables counted from LLM-free runs work
as well as the true generator (Qwen 7B)
EIG/cost vs random, same planner prompt;
What to probe ≠ when to stop
probe choice adds nothing detectable after
No LLM vs the best LLM configuration:
strong models wait for confirming evidence
Public SOC data cannot test this
ExCyTIn, GUIDE and OTRF: the alert names
the answer, or labels follow policy
Put the procedure outside the model.
What remains for the model: judging when evidence suffices,
and reading raw telemetry into the observations the controller consumes.
